SELECT DATE(ORDERED_AT) AS ORDER_DATE, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS DAILY_TOTAL FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDERED_AT >= #since#
STATUS = #status#
GROUP BY DATE(ORDERED_AT) ORDER BY ORDER_DATE ASC

SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.UNIT_PRICE) AS REVENUE FROM CATEGORIES C INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON C.CATEGORY_ID = P.CATEGORY_ID INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY REVENUE DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT, COALESCE(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) AS PAID_SO_FAR FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN PAYMENTS P ON O.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID AND P.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' WHERE O.STATUS = 'PENDING' GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT HAVING O.TOTAL_AMOUNT > COALESCE(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0)

SELECT CO.COUPON_CODE, CO.DISCOUNT_RATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDERED_AT BETWEEN CO.START_DATE AND CO.END_DATE) AS ORDERS_IN_WINDOW FROM COUPONS CO WHERE CO.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
CO.DISCOUNT_RATE >= #minDiscountRate#

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, I.QUANTITY, W.WAREHOUSE_NAME FROM INVENTORY I INNER JOIN PRODUCTS P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN WAREHOUSES W ON I.WAREHOUSE_ID = W.WAREHOUSE_ID WHERE I.QUANTITY < #threshold# ORDER BY I.QUANTITY ASC

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USERNAME, COUNT(N.NOTIFICATION_ID) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM USERS U INNER JOIN NOTIFICATIONS N ON U.USER_ID = N.USER_ID AND N.IS_READ = 0 GROUP BY U.USER_ID, U.USERNAME HAVING COUNT(N.NOTIFICATION_ID) > 0 ORDER BY UNREAD_COUNT DESC
